rows.grounds: ablative of cause/instrument in ritual context; compound marīca+homāt
resultative verb in ritual outcome statement

items.question: What fatal outcome befalls an enemy as a result of a pepper oblation?
premises: A pepper oblation is performed as a ritual act.
The enemy is the target affected by this ritual act.
The ritual act produces its result invariably at all times.
items.inference: Performing a pepper oblation causes the enemy to meet death.
items.plain_english: From an oblation of pepper, the enemy always meets death.
